$comment: Named, versioned machine-verification suite for cinatra-ai/apollo-prospecting-agent — the gate-arm half of the truthful verification-record model (the Truthful Attribution protocol §4). The truthful-attribution-gate reads THIS file at the merged SHA (authoritative, no TOCTOU) when a merge record carries a Gate-suite arm: the cited suiteId@version must equal this file's, the Accountable trailer must equal accountable{github,name,email}, and every requiredContexts entry must have concluded success on the reviewed head. requiredContexts names every check this repository's own workflows run on each pull request into main: each reusable gate with the reusable workflow it calls, the sha this repository's own caller pins for it, that caller's path and the events it runs on; each job of these workflows that calls no reusable workflow by its context alone, with no workflow/pinned pair; and the truthful-attribution-gate context, whose engine pin lives in its caller's uses: line (itself a high-risk path). A change that moves one of these caller pins moves the matching pinned value here in the same commit and bumps the version. highRiskPaths EXTENDS the central cinatra-ai/ci defaults (the gate verifies the effective set is a superset). High-risk changes (this file is itself one — see **/gate-suite.json) require the HUMAN arm at tier=maintainer or the maintainer's standing authority; the gate arm alone is rejected, so this file's birth never rests on a self-blessing gate arm. lastAuditedAt + auditEvidence are the §4 monthly-audit record; the Accountable engineer re-audits monthly and bumps BOTH coupled in one commit (the gate warns >35d, fails the gate arm >65d; the human arm is always still available).
auditEvidence: 2026-11-17 re-audit: all 8 requiredContexts exist at main - actions-pinned-gate.yml, ci.yml, docs-meta-commentary.yml, gitignore-gate.yml, secret-scan-gate.yml, source-leak-gate.yml, truthful-attribution-gate.yml - the callers of the 6 reusable gates with the called jobs of the same ids produce the declared context names, and build and kind-gates are jobs of ci.yml that call no reusable workflow; pins 4c903fe9 (actions-pinned-gate), 533a12a6 (meta-commentary-gate), 4c903fe9 (gitignore-gate), a8677e50 (secret-scan-gate), 00ac7b92 (source-leak-gate), 7c767fe7 (truthful-attribution-gate) equal their callers' uses: SHAs and, where the caller passes one, its ref: input (the secret-scan-gate caller passes no ref: input); the truthful-attribution-gate callerPath equals that caller's own path and its allowedEvents (pull_request, push) cover that caller's triggers (pull_request, push); 7c767fe7 is a supported engine SHA of the merge road (grant revision 3) and the attribution caller runs the same commit; the central high-risk defaults read version 2026.06 with 35 globs at each of the ten supported engine SHAs and all 35 are in the 35 highRiskPaths (none missing; 0 repository extensions); accountable unchanged (Sandro Groganz, sandro@cinatra.ai, groganz); recorded, not changed: the active branch ruleset requiring actions-pinned-gate / actions-pinned-gate, gitignore-gate / gitignore-gate, kind-gates, secret-scan-gate / secret-scan-gate, source-leak-gate / source-leak-gate. Not read: the check runs at the main head. Commands: checkout reads of the suite and its callers, git reads of the called reusable workflows at their pins and of config/high-risk-defaults.json at each supported engine, one ruleset read. The attribution row's pinned engine and the caller's uses: line and ref: input advance from 1e40675e to 7c767fe7 (grant revision 3), with mode warn and the caller's other inputs and its permissions unchanged; the version moves from 2026.09.1 to 2026.11.1, as a new pin is a material suite change.
